task.source_name: Ripple issue-linked change dataset (record instance-00165; used for candidate discovery and cross-check only)
task.issue_text_source: ASF Jira REST API v2 issue IVY-1522 fields created,summary,description; retrieved 2026-11-06T02:42:31+00:00; https://issues.apache.org/jira/rest/api/2/issue/IVY-1522?fields=created,summary,description
task.selection_decision: From scripts/screen_tasks.py: Jira creation time precedes the target commit, the recorded parent is the target's first parent, and labels are the complete parent-to-target Git diff path set. Confirmed by the reviewers named in cleaning_decisions. Ripple impact-set-files is not used as ground truth.
cleaning_decisions: Ground truth is the exact Git diff path set from parent to target; do not substitute Ripple impact-set-files.

Issue text is the Jira summary and opening problem statement, manually cleaned: follow-up discussion, contact details and any fix description removed; no patch, commit message or changed-file list is included.

allowed: candidate paths selected from the parent tree (production Java, tests, non-Java text files; label-free rule)
predictor_input_policy.constraint_type: candidate-list prompt constraint; strict validation still enforced after generation

baselines.seed_selection: first deterministic lexical source rank from request text against parent snapshot

limitations: A single model call is one sample; repeated calls can differ in lower ranks.
Changed-path labels are not a complete oracle for every file potentially affected.
Issue cleaning decisions are recorded in the task manifest.
C0_CONSTRAINED is a candidate-list prompt condition, not a hard decoding constraint; invalid paths are still rejected.
